improvements.rationale: Search engines display meta descriptions in results, directly impacting click-through rates. Open Graph tags control how the page appears when shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, and Twitter—critical channels for reaching business professionals. The copy highlights the free trial offer to reduce friction, mentions Claude-powered credibility, and stays within verified site context. Without these tags, search engines auto-generate snippets and social platforms show generic previews, reducing trust and conversions.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace to streamline your operations. Try three searches free, no card required."
improvements.rationale: This copy immediately establishes what Gideon is (AI assistant for trade/business), highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace), and removes friction by emphasizing the free trial with no payment commitment. The structure moves from benefit to action, guiding visitors toward trying the product.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing Gideon. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30 percent with annual billing. As a member, you'll unlock unlimited access to your personal workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support whenever you need it.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the conversion funnel—what happens at the paywall. It transparently explains the transition from free trial to paid membership, reinforces value (unlimited workspace, voice chat, professional support), and highlights the annual savings incentive. Clarity here reduces bounce rates and builds trust with prospective members.
